column3: (User controllable attribute: by design, forms re-render the submitted values after a validation error (and ?project= pre-fills the new-memory form). React escapes attribute values, and the nonce CSP blocks injected scripts.)
(Non-storable content: intended. Signed-in pages carry memories and are sent private, no-store.)
(Modern web application: informational hint to use the Ajax spider, not a vulnerability.)
(Anti-CSRF tokens: Next.js Server Actions reject requests whose Origin does not match the Host, the session cookie is SameSite=Strict, and the GET filter form has no side effects.)
